Bright hello support crew,
Productive middle at the desk, and water bowls came up with renewed urgency across the live queue. We need brisk attention on every active animal file, because the cabin team is already fielding passenger concerns and the next wave of departures will not tolerate avoidable gaps. Please keep reviews calm, precise, and fully documented so that comfort measures and handler notes remain aligned from intake through handoff.

<<FACT F085>> I am asking everyone to verify the supporting details before any file moves onward, especially where temperament, feeding notes, and carrier readiness appear uneven. If a traveler has raised concern, keep the tone measured and pass the matter to the senior coordinator without delay. The goal is to protect the animal, reduce confusion at the counter, and keep the service path steady for Aurelia Skyways.

<<FACT F108>> When an incident appears likely, capture the facts cleanly and escalate at once through the proper channel. Do not improvise, do not leave partial notes, and do not assume the cabin team can recover missing context later. A clear record now will save us from a larger disruption later, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk must stay disciplined under pressure.

Please remain vigilant, support one another, and keep the workflow moving with care and speed.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
